Detailed Description

Performs a linear line from start to end over a given duration.

e.g., 

  UGen line = LLine::AR(B(0.0, 1.0), B(0.25, 0.7), 5);

.. a two channel audio rate line over 5 seconds where the "left" channel ramps from 0.0 to 0.25 while the "right" channel ramps from 1.0 to 0.7.

See also:
XLine, Linen, Env, EnvGen, ASR

Base LLine Constuctor, use the AR() and KR() versions in user code.

Generic UGen argument documentation: Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions). Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being created is made multichannel via other arguments. Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)

Parameters:
start The starting value, this may be multichannel by storing the starting values in a single channel Buffer.
end The ending value, this may be multichannel by storing the ending values in a single channel Buffer.
duration The duration the line should take to ramp from the starting values to the ending value, this may be multichannel by storing the durations in a single channel Buffer.
doneAction The DoneAction to perform after the line has finished, the default is to delete the UGen graph.
